title: Huddle presets (teammates)
description: huddle-presets.json (global, in the data folder root) and profiles/<slug>/huddle-presets.json (one board): a JSON array of huddle role presets, shown as teammates in the UI. Type HuddlePreset in src/huddle/huddle-presets.ts; written by Store.saveHuddlePresets (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename). Merged built-in -> global -> board by name. Read with cleanPresets, which keeps only entries presetFromInput accepts (a name and a prompt are enough; the rest gets defaults), drops repeated names, and rebuilds each entry, so the Bun daemon drops unknown fields on the next save. Every entry it writes has all eight fields. A port may drop unknown fields here too, as the Bun daemon does.

name.description: presetName(): lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 24 chars; not you, all, system or current. Unique in the file.

role.description: Label shown in the huddle, e.g. "QA lead".

canEdit.description: May change files; then workspace is own (except the main preset).
